description.value: Elysian Coffee Roasters is a Vancouver-based specialty coffee company that sources, roasts, and serves its own beans across four neighbourhood cafés. The Mount Pleasant location at 7th & Ontario sits in a cycling-friendly district and offers both indoor and outdoor seating in a wheelchair-accessible space. The roastery's founding philosophy — consistently good coffee made by happy, well-led staff — has expanded into a subscription service and online shop alongside the in-person café experience.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 7m; rack (6 spaces) at 8m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Mount Pleasant location at 2301 Ontario Street with postal code V5T 2X5, matching the OSM address exactly. The site is an active e-commerce and café presence with a 2026-03-19 OSM check_date, confirming the business is open. Neither the OSM tags nor the website content mention bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities, so those fields remain null; the diet:vegetarian OSM tag is not corroborated by the website content and is therefore left null per the rules.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM record or on the website contact page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An established, active specialty coffee roaster with a confirmed Vancouver location and accessible outdoor seating; a practical and appealing café stop for touring cyclists passing through Mount Pleasant.
